name: Santa's Countdown
author: BigC07
description: An animated countdown to Christmas for kids: Santa's sleigh and reindeer, a waving snowman, bouncing presents, dancing gingerbread men, chasing lights, Santa's boots kicking in a chimney and elves tossing presents -- a different scene each time it comes round. All art drawn in code; no network.

versions.notes: First release. Seven animated scenes drawn in code -- sleigh, snowman, presents, gingerbread, lights, chimney, elves -- shown in turn (or at random), with the days left until Christmas, and MERRY CHRISTMAS! on the day. Shows from season_start (1 November by default) through Christmas Day and stays off the rest of the year. In Vegas it is one live element the ticker redraws in place, so the card animates while it scrolls (core 3.8.0+; older cores get a still frame), and it moves to the next scene every lap, even with nothing else in the rotation.
